bottlenecks.title: Agent commit_rewrite failed
bottlenecks.evidence: the agent failed: the full-history rewrite failed its own anonymity/syntax check (41 hard leak(s) {'tokens_head': 38, 'emails_head': 3}, parse_ok=True): stopping now instead of v
bottlenecks.advice: Open the agent's log under _private/swarm/logs/. Everything that depends on it was skipped.

bottlenecks.title: commit_rewrite is the critical-path bottleneck
bottlenecks.advice: The single history rewrite is blob-bound (every file version is transformed, with an AST syntax guard on changed Python). Fewer renamed identifiers (scope the rename to symbols whose every reference is in scope) and more rewrite processes (--procs) shorten it.

bottlenecks.title: 61% of the run had only one agent working
bottlenecks.advice: Work that could overlap runs one-at-a-time. Check dependencies of these agents for something that can move earlier.

bottlenecks.title: LLM calls were queued behind the worker limit
bottlenecks.evidence: 99% of LLM-busy time was at the limit (mean 4.1 workers)
bottlenecks.advice: More workers help up to ~12 on this account (20 was slower: provider throttling). If workers were held down by memory, give the container more.

bottlenecks.title: The names stage used the most LLM time
bottlenecks.evidence: 6215s of call time over 475 calls (510.6 items/min)
bottlenecks.advice: Fewer items (scope) is the lever that scales; per-call speed is bounded by the model.
